SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-20: CQL — Aggregate Functions. Test these items: AllTrue(list), AnyTrue(list), Avg(list), Count(list), GeometricMean(list), Max(list), Min(list), Median(list), Mode(list), PopulationStdDev(list), PopulationVariance(list), Product(list), StdDev(list), Sum(list), Variance(list). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Appendix B Aggregate Functions - Min/Max (orderable types incl. Quantity)
issues.evidence: e2e population SQL: define Vals: (from [Observation] O return O.value as Quantity); Min(Vals) emits LEAST((SELECT sub.value FROM Vals sub WHERE sub.patient_id=_pt.patient_id LIMIT 1)) - aggregate sees ONLY THE FIRST row. P1 values {120mg,80mg}: Min returned 120 (spec: 80). Max/Median(Vals) same LIMIT-1 wrap. Probe: .temp/qa/cql20agg_skeptic_probe3.py
issues.root_cause: Scalar-subquery consumption of element-rows defines saw only the first row; quantity row-aggregates compared JSON strings lexicographically.
issues.resolution: Rows-define/query-Quantity aggregates now materialize the per-patient element LIST (or inline the definition AST for non-CTE-backed sources) and dispatch list-semantics aggregation (_translate_list_aggregate_dispatch, _element_rows_define_list in _functions.py). Min({120,80}mg)=80mg verified e2e.

issues.evidence: Same Vals define: Sum(Vals)/Avg(Vals)/PopulationStdDev/PopulationVariance -> BinderException 'column patient_id must appear in GROUP BY'; Median/StdDev/Variance/Product -> Binder 'Invalid LIST argument during lambda binding'. Spec defines Quantity overloads for all of these; none execute over query-derived Quantity lists.
issues.root_cause: Quantity statistical path embedded the list sum (a subquery for dynamic lists) inside list_transform lambda bodies (DuckDB forbids); rows-define consumption hit GROUP BY binder errors.
issues.resolution: Same dispatcher: Quantity unit-aware helpers for Sum/Avg/Min/Max plus a hoisted derived-table shape for the statistical family (Median/StdDev/Variance/Population*/Product) so no subquery appears inside list_transform lambdas (DuckDB restriction). All execute e2e.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Appendix B - Min/Max overloads List<Date>/List<DateTime>/List<Time>
issues.evidence: define Dates: (from [Observation] O return O.effective as dateTime); Min(Dates) -> TranslationError 'Min does not support List<dateTime> source'. FHIR choice-type name 'dateTime' is not normalized to CQL 'DateTime' in _validate_static_aggregate_argument/_static_list_element_types. Literal DateTime lists work.
issues.root_cause: FHIR choice-type names (dateTime) never canonicalized to CQL type names in static element-type inference, so spec overload allowlists rejected them.
issues.resolution: _FHIR_TO_CQL_TYPE_NAMES canonicalization in _type_spec_name + _from_cql_type: FHIR choice-cast names (dateTime/instant/...) map to CQL spellings so Min/Max DateTime/Date/Time overloads are accepted.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Appendix B - AllTrue/AnyTrue over query sources
issues.evidence: AllTrue((from [Observation] O return O.status='final')) emits SELECT patient_id, COALESCE(bool_and(_val),TRUE) FROM (SELECT O.status='final' AS _val FROM Observation O WHERE O.patient_id = _agg.patient_id) AS _agg - correlation predicate references _agg alias from inside the subquery + missing GROUP BY -> BinderException 'Referenced table _agg not found'. Same for AnyTrue. Literal-derived query sources pass; retrieve-backed queries fail.
issues.root_cause: UNKNOWN-shape CTE wrapping unwrapped scalar aggregate subqueries and rewrote the correct outer _pt correlation to the derived-table alias, producing self-referential SQL.
issues.resolution: cte_manager._wrap_definition_cte UNKNOWN branch: scalar aggregate subqueries and single-column selects over DERIVED tables keep their outer _pt correlation (guard _is_scalar_aggregate_select / _from_is_derived) instead of being unwrapped and alias-rewritten into self-referential SQL.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Appendix B - Mode(argument List<T>) T
issues.evidence: Mode(Patient.name.given) -> BinderException 'UNNEST() for correlated expressions is not supported' (SQL: MODE(fhirpath_text(_pt.patient_resource,'name.given')) - scalar MODE over a JSON list value, never unnested). Literal lists work (CQLListMode path).
issues.root_cause: Mode fell through to scalar DuckDB MODE() over an un-nested JSON list value.
issues.resolution: Mode over dynamic multi-valued properties promotes fhirpath_text to the from_json element list and routes through CQLListMode.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Appendix B - Product(argument List<Integer>) Integer / List<Long> Long
issues.evidence: Product({1,2,3,4}) returns Decimal('24.00000000') - typed Decimal rather than Integer (spec Integer overload). Sum received exact typed treatment in CQL-01 doctrine (list_aggregate sum + TRY_CAST to INTEGER/BIGINT); Product still routes through DOUBLE + DECIMAL(38,8).
issues.root_cause: Product always routed through DOUBLE + DECIMAL(38,8) even for integral element types.
issues.resolution: Product(List<Integer>)/(List<Long>) lowered to exact list_aggregate 'product' + TRY_CAST to INTEGER/BIGINT (overflow -> null), mirroring the CQL-01 Sum doctrine; implemented both in the literal path and the dispatcher.

issues.evidence: ARCHITECT audit: typed Sum/Avg/Product lowering exists in both the literal path and the new _translate_list_aggregate_dispatch (identical semantics, dual source of truth); _is_scalar_aggregate_select sniffs SQL function names where the _from_is_derived structural guard is the more general invariant.
issues.root_cause: Incremental surgical fix pattern; consolidation is a hygiene refactor outside this chunk.
issues.resolution: Deferred to a future consolidation pass; both paths pinned by parity tests.
